items.briefing:
Asia Pacific leaders are calling for stronger defences against scams, a timely reminder for Australian organisations to review how they protect staff and customers from fraud attempts. Separately, AI tools are creating new security risks — poorly configured AI models are opening up vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit, and security experts warn that AI is challenging traditional trust-based network defences.

For organisations using AI platforms or automation tools, now is a good time to check that your AI systems are properly configured and access is appropriately restricted. **Practical tip:** Ask your IT team to confirm that any AI tools in use have been securely set up and are regularly reviewed.
